literature_notes: L1 (PMC10495444) reports full-length hXKR8 constructs carrying an N-terminal V5 tag and a C-terminal FLAG tag in lentiviral expression vectors — genuine membrane-anchored, full-length tagged proteins. However, the authoritative computed topology places residues 1–12 (the N-terminus) in the INTRACELLULAR compartment and residues 339–395 (the C-terminus) also INTRACELLULAR. Both tags therefore face the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface; they qualify only as intracellular-terminus insertions and are recorded in other_positions. L2 (PMC13178662) concerns mouse XK (a distinct gene), not XKR8, and reports mutagenesis of E119/E121 in a C-terminally mEGFP-tagged XK construct — not a tag insertion in XKR8 at all. It provides no qualifying evidence for any XKR8 site. The five extracellular loops of XKR8 (EC 36–42, 155–161, 211, 247–258, 306–317) are all short (1–12 residues) and none is supported by any ledger insertion. Zero extracellular surface tag sites qualify.
